# Feature Request

## Summary

Provide a short description of the proposed feature.

---

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem this feature would solve.

Example:

> I often have hundreds of files in my Downloads folder and would like them to be organized automatically based on file age.

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe your preferred solution.

Be as detailed as possible.

---

## Example Workflow

```text
Downloads

↓

Scan Files

↓

Apply Smart Rules

↓

Move Files

↓

Generate Summary
```

---

## Example Configuration

If applicable, include a sample configuration.

```json
{}
```

---

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative approaches you considered.

---

## Benefits

How would this feature improve the project?

Examples:

- Better usability
- Better performance
- Better automation
- Improved maintainability
- Better developer experience

---

## Possible Drawbacks

Are there any disadvantages or trade-offs?

Examples:

- Additional complexity
- Breaking changes
- Performance impact
- More configuration

---

## Affected Modules

Select all that may be affected.

- [ ] Config
- [ ] Validation
- [ ] Scanner
- [ ] Classifier
- [ ] SmartClassifier
- [ ] Mover
- [ ] Logger
- [ ] Summary
- [ ] Models
- [ ] Utils
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests

---

## Priority

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High
- [ ] Critical

---

## Additional Notes

Include any mockups, diagrams, references, or examples that may help explain the feature.

# Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing feature requests.
